nodes.label: White Masterbatch — Macro Close-up of Pure White Spherical Pellets
White Masterbatch Pellets
nodes.visual_subject: Macro close-up of a spread of small spherical white plastic masterbatch pellets/granules piled against a plain white background with soft shadow and depth of field.
nodes.mood_style: Minimalist, almost monochrome studio macro; soft natural light; clean and clinical; emphasises the purity and quality of white pigment masterbatch.

edges.note: White masterbatch pellets are the upstream raw material that produces white or opaque plastic films used in the packaging industry.
Masterbatch pellets (white base + colour concentrate) are the direct precursor raw material to colour-moulded consumer goods plastic parts.
Masterbatch pellets are compounded into HDPE resin before pipe extrusion; pellets represent the upstream input for all plastic pipe products.
Masterbatch pellets are blended into cable jacket compounds; the white base pellet is a fundamental raw material for wire and cable sheathing.
Agricultural films are produced from polyethylene compounded with masterbatch; white and UV-stabiliser masterbatches are key inputs for greenhouse film.
Colour masterbatch pellets are used in fibre spinning to produce coloured synthetic yarns; white base pellets link to the textiles supply chain.
Masterbatch pellets are compounded into automotive-grade polymers; black and colour masterbatches are essential for automotive interior moulded parts.
Black and carbon-black masterbatch pellets are compounded into HDPE/LLDPE geomembrane sheets for UV resistance in construction applications.
